purpose: Test whether the known 2013 H10S1 electronic-noise/cross-talk epoch is visible directly in public HA10 waveform data as a change in south-triplet channel coupling and/or south-vs-north broadband scale, while keeping independent seabed geometry as a separate evidence lane.

historical_anchor.published_description: Electrical noise appeared on H10S1 and evolved to strong persistent noise with varying cross-talk to H10S2 and H10S3; CTBTO material reports calibration-response changes around the same epoch.

window_contract.rationale: March and September 2013 mirror the before/after months used in the published CTBTO calibration comparison while keeping all waveform windows frozen before retrieval.

broadband_power: per-channel response-corrected integrated 10-80 Hz power where response metadata are available
S2-minus-N1 and S3-minus-N1 dB medians pre vs post
coupling: median magnitude-squared coherence in 10-80 Hz for S1-S2 and S1-S3
same coherence for N1-N2 and N1-N3 as temporal/control reference
absolute zero-lag Pearson correlation after fixed 10-80 Hz band-pass for the same pairs

decision_rule.BLOCKED: If either epoch has fewer than 12 windows complete on all six channels.
decision_rule.SUPPORTED_POST_2013_SOUTH_TRIPLET_COUPLI: If all four preregistered coupling thresholds pass.
decision_rule.NO_STRONG_POST_2013_SOUTH_TRIPLET_COUPLI: If data are sufficient but one or more coupling thresholds fail.
decision_rule.note: The broadband S2/N1 and S3/N1 pre/post changes are reported independently and do not by themselves decide the coupling verdict.

interpretation_firewall.a_supported_coupling_change_means: Public waveform data contain a south-triplet coupling change temporally consistent with the known fault epoch, strengthening cross-talk as a confounder.
a_supported_coupling_change_does_not_mea: the full 12-13 dB S2/N1 offset is proven instrumental
riser failure is proven as the exact physical cause
any physical seafloor structure is absent
interpretation_firewall.a_negative_coupling_result_means: This specific raw-waveform coupling signature was not strongly recovered under the frozen metric; it does not erase the published CTBTO fault history.

janus_method.pipeline: OBSERVATION -> REVERSE_TO_2013_FAULT_BOUNDARY -> PRE_POST_DISCRIMINATOR -> NORTH_CONTROL -> RAW_THEN_CORRECTED -> HRAIN_INAIHR_REVIEW -> NEXT_GATE
janus_method.after_result: Return the receipt to Janus-Demiurge/Janus council and require the next gate to discriminate the strongest surviving sibling hypotheses rather than merely repeat the same statistic.
